title: Mixture of experts routing
hook: A gate picks a few feed-forward networks per token, so storage grows with experts while work grows only with how many each token uses.

verified.claim: HiDream's gate uses softmax and topk, with norm_topk_prob False and aux_loss None.
forward routes tokens to experts, sums by weight, and adds shared_experts.
Hunyuan 3D v2.1 uses MoEBlock only for the last num_moe_layers.
Routed and brute-force outputs match exactly in the lab.
Switch Transformers routes each token to one expert and adds an auxiliary loss to balance the load.

unchecked: The graph hunyuan3d_mesh is not confirmed to load a v2.1 model; it says Hunyuan3D 2. We use it only to show the family.
No trained expert routing was measured here.
